lines.japanese: 自分のブースへ戻る前に、同行者へ一声かけておこうと思った。
lines.english: I figured I should say something to my companion before heading back to my booth.

lines.japanese: 「香田」
lines.english: “Koda.”

lines.japanese: カップを持っていない方の手で、お隣りさんの簡易扉をノックする。返事がない。
lines.english: With the hand that wasn't holding my mug, I knocked on the flimsy door beside mine. No answer.

lines.japanese: 「仕方ない、帰るか」
lines.english: “Oh well. Guess I'll go home.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょーっ！　待てよーう！」
lines.english: “Heeey! Wait up!”

lines.japanese: 扉が勢いよく開いた。窮屈な個室の中、リクライニングシートに体育座りしている亜衣の体が、椅子ごとこっちを向いていた。パンツは見えそうで見えなかった。どうでもいい。超どうでもいい。
lines.english: The door flew open. Inside the cramped cubicle, Ai sat curled up on the reclining chair with her knees to her chest, and the whole chair had swiveled to face me. Her underwear came close to showing, but didn’t. I didn’t care. I could not possibly have cared less.

lines.japanese: 「ひと置いて勝手に帰んなしー！」
lines.english: “Don't just leave me behind!”

lines.japanese: 「じゃ返事ぐらいしろよ」
lines.english: “Then answer when I call you.”

lines.japanese: 「あそか。ゴメン、ちょっと考え事してて反応遅れちった、てへへ」
lines.english: “Oh, right. Sorry. I was thinking about stuff, so it took me a second to notice. Heh.”

lines.japanese: そういやテレビもパソコンも付いてない。こんな圧迫感のきっつい無音空間で膝を抱えてたら、そりゃ物思いにも捕われようってもんだ。
lines.english: The TV and computer were both off. Sitting with her knees drawn up in dead silence, in a booth this cramped and oppressive, who wouldn’t get lost in thought?

lines.japanese: つか、よく見りゃこいつ、目ぇ赤いじゃねえか。なにが考え事だ、ただ寝てただけだろてめえ。
lines.english: Wait, now that I looked, her eyes were red. What thinking? You were just asleep, dumbass.

lines.japanese: 「まー、立ち話もなんだから入んなよ」
lines.english: “Well, no point talking in the doorway. Come on in.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、こっち用事済んだから、もう帰れンだけど。つか、帰ろうぜって言いに来たんだけど」
lines.english: “No, I’m done with my stuff, so I can head home now. I mean, I came over to tell you we should get going.”

lines.japanese: つか、イス一個っきゃねーんだから、どのみち立ち話になるっつうの。
lines.english: Besides, there was only one chair. We'd be talking standing up either way.

lines.japanese: 「いいからおいで。ね、ねッ！」
lines.english: “Just come in. Please? Please!”

lines.japanese: 香田はばんばんと自分の座席を叩く。仕方ない。このままここで押し問答を続けてたら、俺が通行人に疎まれそうだ。
lines.english: Koda thumped the seat she was sitting on a few times. Fine. If we kept arguing in the doorway, I’d start annoying the people trying to get past.

lines.japanese: 俺はマグカップの味噌汁を啜りながらブースの内側に入った。ひとりでも狭いのに、ふたり入ったらバリクソ狭い。
lines.english: I stepped into the booth, sipping miso soup from my mug. It was tight with one person inside. With two, it was insanely goddamn tight.

lines.japanese: 「で？　Ｒなんとかのサイトは見られたん？」
lines.english: “So? Did you get to see the R-whatever website?”

lines.japanese: 「一応。だからもうやることねーんだよな。帰んね？」
lines.english: “More or less. So I've got nothing left to do. Wanna head home?”

lines.japanese: カップに口を付けながら、ぽつんと置かれたマンガ本を拾う。やたら目のでかい女が表紙の、少女コミックだった。
lines.english: Mug at my lips, I picked up the lone comic book. It was a girls' comic with a huge-eyed woman on the cover.

lines.japanese: なんとはなしに、ぱらぱらめくってみる。リリカルな顔をして星を飛ばした中学生（と書いてあった）が、男の顔の上でスカートのまま顔面騎乗していた。
lines.english: For no particular reason, I flipped through it. A middle-school girl—the book said she was one—wore a lyrical expression as stars sparkled around her, while she sat astride a boy’s face with her skirt still on.

lines.japanese: 「ええええ、ちょっ……なんだコレ、ただのエロ本だろ。なんでコレ対象年齢１８歳以上のマーク付いてないの」
lines.english: “Whaaat? Hold on... What is this, straight-up porn? Why doesn’t it have an eighteen-and-over label?”

lines.japanese: 「隼人君ふるーい。最近の少女漫画、そんぐらいフツーだよ」
lines.english: “You’re so behind the times, Hayato. That’s perfectly normal in girls’ manga now.”

lines.japanese: 「マジかよ。小学生がこんなんフツーに買っちゃうの。すげえな小学生。最近の文部科学省って超放任主義なんだな。つうかコレもはや少女漫画じゃねーだろ、熟女漫画だろ」
lines.english: Seriously? Elementary-school kids can just walk in and buy this stuff? Kids are incredible. The Ministry of Education these days must have one hell of a hands-off policy. And this isn't girls' manga anymore. It's middle-aged-lady manga.

lines.japanese: 「あはは。落ちつけって、おっちゃん」
lines.english: “Ha ha. Settle down, old man.”

lines.japanese: 「なーなー。八頭身の小学生モデルが、ホスト風のイケメン三人を手玉に取ってほくそ笑んでるコマが目に入ったんだけど、このマンガどんなストーリーなわけ」
lines.english: “Hey, hey. I just saw a panel of a grade-school model built like a fashion sketch, smirking while she played three host-looking pretty boys against each other. What is this comic even about?”

lines.japanese: 「え？　あー、知んない。まだ読んでないし」
lines.english: “What? Oh, I don't know. I haven't read it yet.”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　そーなの？」
lines.english: “Huh? You haven't?”

lines.japanese: マンガも読まない、テレビも見ない。体育座りはする。いったい何しに来たんだ、こいつ。
lines.english: She wasn't reading the comic. She wasn't watching television. She *was* sitting there with her knees drawn up. What had she even come here for?

lines.japanese: ああ、俺の付き合いか。
lines.english: Oh. To keep me company.

lines.japanese: なにげなく店の壁時計を見る。意外。活字慣れしてない俺は、インターネットをするのにいつの間にか結構な時間を費やしていたらしい。
lines.english: I glanced at the clock on the wall and blinked. Not being much of a reader, I’d spent a surprising amount of time on the internet without noticing.

lines.japanese: 香田は俺の驚きに気付いたようだ。
lines.english: Koda seemed to notice my surprise.

lines.japanese: 「さんざん待たせといて、自分の用が済んだらオラ帰んぞって。何ソレ、隼人君どんだけ俺様すか」
lines.english: “You make me wait forever, and the moment you’re done, it’s ‘Come on, we’re leaving’? Seriously, Hayato, how full of yourself can you get?”

lines.japanese: それほど怒ってる感じではなかったが、言ってることはまっとうで反論できない。
lines.english: She didn't sound particularly angry, but her point was fair, and I had no answer for it.

lines.japanese: 悪り、と謝ったら、やつはニンマリ笑った。
lines.english: When I said sorry, she broke into a broad grin.

lines.japanese: 「ここ座って」
lines.english: “Sit here.”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「いーから、ここ座ってよ」
lines.english: “Just sit here, okay?”

lines.japanese: やつがシートの上で片端に寄ると、そこに常人の尻幅のわずか三分の一ほどのスペースができた。超狭い。
lines.english: She scooted to one end, leaving about a third of a normal butt’s worth of room. Nowhere near enough.

lines.japanese: 「いや、おまえソレ、座るとかそういうレベルの話じゃねーだろ。その空間に尻を入れようと思ったら、どんだけ骨盤矯正すればいいんだよ」
lines.english: “You can't call that room to sit. How much would I have to rearrange my pelvis to fit it into that space?”

lines.japanese: 「んじゃ──」
lines.english: “Then—”

lines.japanese: 亜衣はいったん尻を浮かせて、シートの肘掛けに座りなおした。そして丸々空いた座面をぽんぽん叩く。
lines.english: Ai lifted herself from the cushion and resettled on the chair's arm. Then she patted the seat she had left completely open.

lines.japanese: 「──ハイ、これでいいでしょ？　座って」
lines.english: “There. Better? Sit down.”

lines.japanese: 断る理由がなくなってしまった。俺はマグカップをテレビの脇に置いて、結構ふかふかなシートに腰を下ろした。結構ふかふかな座面には、やつの尻の温度が残っていた。
lines.english: Now I had no reason left to say no. I put my mug beside the TV and sat down on the pretty plush seat. The pretty plush cushion was still warm from her butt.

lines.japanese: 「はー、よっこいしょ」
lines.english: “Hup we go.”

lines.japanese: ババくさい掛け声がしたかと思うや、止める間もなく香田の尻がのしかかってきた。
lines.english: She gave an old-lady heave-ho, and before I could stop her, Koda's ass came crashing down on me.
“What...?”

lines.japanese: 正面、至近距離にやつの顔。それなりに鍛えてある俺の硬いももの上で、やつの細いももが歪んでいた。細いわりに肉質がある。
lines.english: Her face was directly in front of mine, far too close. Her slender thighs pressed out of shape against my hard, reasonably well-trained ones. Slender as they were, they had some substance to them.

lines.japanese: 「どけばか」
lines.english: “Get off, idiot.”

lines.japanese: 「ぎゃー！　おち、落ちるっ！　隼人君、ちょ待って！」
lines.english: “Aah! I-I’m falling! Hayato, wait!”

lines.japanese: 俺が強引に立ちあがろうとしたら、かえって亜衣は両手を回してしがみついてきた。
lines.english: When I tried to force myself to my feet, Ai only wrapped both arms around me and clung tighter.

lines.japanese: これはもはや抱擁だ。胸と胸がくっついてる。柔らかさと温かさ。ハードボイルドで知られる成田隼人の心臓も、さすがにちょっぴり鼓動を速めた。
lines.english: This was basically a hug now. Chest to chest. Soft. Warm. Even the heart of Hayato Narita, famous for being hard-boiled, started beating a little faster.

lines.japanese: 「ちょーちょーちょー、おいコラ、嫁入り前の娘がなんてことしてんだおまえ。パッと見ほとんど不純異性交遊じゃねーか。店員さんに怒られちゃうだろ、ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ
lines.english: “Hey, hey, hey. What the hell do you think you’re doing, an unmarried girl like you? To anyone looking, this is basically illicit relations. The staff are going to yell at us. I’ll fucking kill you, asshole.”

lines.japanese: 「やぁ～ん、落ちるー！　しっかり掴まってないと、後頭部から落ちて頭蓋骨割れるー！」
lines.english: “Nooo, I’m falling! If I don’t hold on tight, I’ll go down headfirst and crack my skull open!”

lines.japanese: まったく切迫感のない、猫なで声のような悲鳴だった。
lines.english: It was a sugary little shriek, utterly devoid of urgency.

lines.japanese: 「つか、めちゃめちゃ安定してんじゃねーかおまえ。早くどけよ、やり過ぎだぞコレ」
lines.english: “You’re stable as hell. Get off me already. You’ve taken this too far.”

lines.japanese: いまは俺もまだ若干恥ずかしいぐらいで済んでるけど、こんなん続いたらそのうち発情するぞコレ。
lines.english: Right now, I was still only a little embarrassed. If this continued, though, sooner or later I was going to get turned on.

lines.japanese: 自慢じゃないけど、男ってのは恋とか愛とかなくても、体の接触だけでその気になれるんだぞコレ。
lines.english: Not to brag, but a guy doesn’t need romance or love to get in the mood. Physical contact alone can do it.

lines.japanese: ぶっちゃけ今おまえを腕力でむりやり撥ねとばさないのだって、ほんのり名残惜しい気持ちがないこともないからだぞコレてめえブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ。
lines.english: Hell, the reason I wasn't using brute force to throw you off right now was because maybe, just maybe, I didn't totally want this to end, you asshole, I'll fucking kill you.

lines.japanese: 「うわ！　隼人君、胸板厚っ！　ねねね、これやっぱ普段から重いもの持ったりしてるから？」
lines.english: “Whoa! Hayato, your chest is so solid! Hey, hey, is this because you’re always lifting heavy things at work?”

lines.japanese: 「あァ、まァ、そりゃビル壊したり道作ったりしてるしなァ。そりゃゲームの世界で街とか作って満足してる学生どもと一緒にされちゃ困るけど」
lines.english: “Well, yeah. I tear down buildings and build roads. Don’t lump me in with students who make pretend cities in video games and walk away satisfied.”

lines.japanese: 「すごー、硬ーい」
lines.english: “Wow. So hard.”

lines.japanese: 触んな。ちょっと気持ちいいけど触んな。
lines.english: Don’t touch me. It felt kind of nice, but don’t touch me.

lines.japanese: 「とりあえずもう終わり。はい、どいて」
lines.english: “All right, that’s enough. Off you get.”
“Why?!”

lines.japanese: 「なんでもクソもあるか、重くて潰れちゃうっつうの。てか、どう考えたってこの状況は不自然だろ。これじゃオトコ誘ってるビッチにしか見えねえぞおまえ」
lines.english: “What do you mean, why? You're heavy; you're crushing me. And no matter how you look at it, this whole situation is weird. You look like some bitch trying to pick up a man.”

lines.japanese: 「ハアァ！？　ひっど、なんてこと言うんだよ、もー！」
lines.english: “Whaaat?! That’s awful! How could you say that?”

lines.japanese: 香田はいつもの調子で声を張りあげた。相手の笑顔を引きだすための、怒ってみせるポーズ。
lines.english: Koda raised her voice in the usual way. It was an imitation of anger, meant to draw a smile from the other person.

lines.japanese: しかし俺は笑わなかった。曖昧にしたくなかった。中途半端に気を持たせておくことは優しさじゃない。
lines.english: But I didn’t smile. I didn’t want to leave room for doubt. Keeping her hopes half-alive would not have been kindness.

lines.japanese: まったく笑わず、しかし決して嫌がったりもせず、ただ真面目くさったツラで俺は天井を睨んでいた。
lines.english: I stared at the ceiling, my face perfectly serious. I didn’t laugh, but I made no show of disliking it either.

lines.japanese: 「や、ごめん……」
lines.english: “No... I’m sorry.”

lines.japanese: 笑わない俺に、やつが言った。
lines.english: She spoke when she saw I wasn’t smiling.

lines.japanese: 「うん……私、誘ってるかも……」
lines.english: “Yeah... Maybe I am coming on to you...”

lines.japanese: しおらしい声。
lines.english: Her voice had gone meek.

lines.japanese: やめろ。
lines.english: Don’t.

lines.japanese: だから。やめてくれって、そういうのは。
lines.english: That's what I'm saying. Knock that shit off.

lines.japanese: 分かったよ。おまえが真剣なのは分かった。でも俺はそういうの無理なんだ。作りたくないんだよ、情やら絆やらそんなん。
lines.english: I get it. I get that you’re serious. But I can’t do this. I don’t want any attachments or bonds or any of that.

lines.japanese: 「もー、やばいよね私。ひぃー、だっさー」
lines.english: “God, I’m a mess. Ugh, this is so lame.”

lines.japanese: 「や、だってー、隼人君いなくなっちゃうって聞いたら私なんかテンパっちゃってー」
lines.english: “I mean, when I heard you were going to disappear, I kind of panicked—”

lines.japanese: ああ。やっぱアレ信じてたのか。諦めてもらおうと思ったのに逆効果だったな。
lines.english: Oh. So she really had believed that. I had hoped it would make her give up on me, but apparently it had done the opposite.

lines.japanese: 「考えると泣けてくるし、会えなくなる前になんか行動しなくちゃって、そんで抑えらんなくなっちゃった」
lines.english: “I start crying whenever I think about it, and then I think I have to do something before I can’t see you anymore, and then I just can’t hold myself back.”

lines.japanese: 「ま、ここまで来たらアレでしょ。もうついでってゆか？　あの、ほら、ちゅーでもしとく？」
lines.english: “Well, now that we’ve come this far, we might as well, right? I mean... you know. Want to kiss or something?”

lines.japanese: やめろって。震えてんじゃねえか。目ェ笑ってねえよ。
lines.english: I told you to stop. You’re trembling. Your eyes aren’t smiling.

lines.japanese: 「いや」
lines.english: “No.”

lines.japanese: 俺はやつの正面から目を見据えて答えた。
lines.english: I met her eyes straight on as I answered.

lines.japanese: 「やめとこ。正直そのライン超えたら、いろいろ変わっちゃう気する」
lines.english: “Let’s not. Honestly, I feel like a lot of things would change if we crossed that line.”

lines.japanese: 「そんな、大袈裟に考えすぎだってー。キスぐらい、いまどき早い子は小学生でしてんしー」
lines.english: “You’re making way too big a deal out of it. Kids who start early are kissing in grade school these days.”

lines.japanese: でもおまえは早い子じゃないんだろ。慣れてるやつはいちいちそんな前置きしねえよ。
lines.english: But you weren’t one of those kids. Someone with experience wouldn’t need a speech like that first.

lines.japanese: 「ほれ」
lines.english: “Come on.”

lines.japanese: 俺の首へ巻きつけられていた腕に、くっと力がこもる。弱えーよ。躊躇してんじゃねえか。
lines.english: The arms looped around my neck tightened. Barely. She was weak. She was hesitating.

lines.japanese: グロスで濡れたように輝く唇が、のろのろと近付いてきた。引きしめられた瞳孔まで覗ける距離。汗ばんだ額は効きすぎたエアコンのせいか、それとも。
lines.english: Her gloss-bright lips inched toward me. She came close enough for me to see her pupils drawn tight. Was the sweat on her forehead from the overpowered air conditioner, or was it something else?

lines.japanese: 鼻先にやつの生々しい匂いが触れて、瞬間、俺の心臓が跳ねた。
lines.english: Her warm, human scent brushed my nose, and in that instant my heart leaped.

lines.japanese: 不覚。青臭い。超青臭い。いつの間にかこいつのことを可愛いと思っていた。俺は頭ごと視線を逃がす。
lines.english: Damn me. This was so adolescent. Painfully adolescent. Somewhere along the way, I'd started thinking she was cute. I jerked my head away.

lines.japanese: 「……あんさ、おまえさ」
lines.english: “Look, you...”

lines.japanese: 「待って」
lines.english: “Wait.”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 香田の目が一瞬だけ下に向けて逸れかかったけど、こくんと何かを呑みくだす音を接いで、すぐ元の位置へ戻ってきた。
lines.english: Koda’s eyes started to drop for a single instant. Then came the tiny sound of something being swallowed, and they lifted to meet mine again.

lines.japanese: 「あのさ、私ほんとに。いい加減な気持ちじゃなくて。マジで隼人君のこと好きだよ」
lines.english: “Listen, I mean it. I’m not playing around. I really like you, Hayato.”

lines.japanese: 俺は告られた。
lines.english: She had confessed to me.

lines.japanese: 「好き。ちょお好き。やばいぐらい好き」
lines.english: “I like you. I like you so much. So much it’s ridiculous.”

lines.japanese: 耳から沁みこむ甘い情動。
lines.english: The sweet emotion seeped into me through my ears.

lines.japanese: 一瞬、揺らいだ。
lines.english: For one moment, I wavered.

lines.japanese: 「……なんか言えよう」
lines.english: “...Say something.”

lines.japanese: そのとき俺はたしかに迷っていた。
lines.english: In that moment, I truly was torn.

lines.japanese: 流されてしまいたい誘惑とせめぎあっていた。
lines.english: I was struggling against the temptation to let the current carry me away.

lines.japanese: しかし抑えなければならない。俺はじきに消えてゆく身。こいつのことを思えばこそ、中途半端な温情はかけちゃいけないんだ。
lines.english: But I had to hold myself back. I would soon be gone. Precisely because I cared about her, I couldn’t offer her some halfhearted scrap of tenderness.

lines.japanese: 俺はこの女を傷付けたくなかった。
lines.english: I didn’t want to hurt this woman.

lines.japanese: 「ごめん。無理だわ」
lines.english: “I’m sorry. I can’t.”

lines.japanese: いまさら驚くことでもないはずなのに、やつの目ン玉は波打つみたいにゆらゆら揺れた。
lines.english: It shouldn’t have surprised her anymore, but her eyes trembled as though something were rippling through them.

lines.japanese: 「……だめか」
lines.english: “...So it’s no good.”

lines.japanese: 先に逃げたのは香田だった。艶めく唇が遠ざかってゆくのを、俺は名残惜しい気持ちで見送っていた。
lines.english: Koda was the first to retreat. I watched her shining lips recede with a pang of regret.

lines.japanese: 「あんさ」
lines.english: “Listen.”

lines.japanese: 俺は香田が降りるのに手を貸しながら言った。
lines.english: I spoke as I helped Koda down.

lines.japanese: 「俺、いなくなンの本当だけど、おまえとは最後までバカやれる仲で終わりたいから。だから我慢した」
lines.english: “I really am leaving. But I want us to stay the kind of friends who can fool around together until the very end. That’s why I held back.”

lines.japanese: 「そか。おけ」
lines.english: “I see. Okay.”

lines.japanese: やつは笑ってくれた。
lines.english: She smiled for me.

lines.japanese: 見え見えの作り笑いだったけど、俺にはそれが有難かった。
lines.english: It was an obvious fake, but I was grateful for it.

lines.japanese: 認めるよ。おまえはマジでいい女だ。
lines.english: I'll admit it. You really are one hell of a woman.

lines.japanese: おまえならすぐにハンパねえレベルのイイ男が捕まるって。そんでこんな、金なし愛想なし甲斐性なしの駄メンに一瞬だけ惚れてしまった失態なんて、すぐにさっぱり忘れてしまうんだ。
lines.english: You'll land yourself an incredible man in no time. Then you'll forget all about that brief lapse in judgment when you fell for some hopeless loser with no money, no charm, and nothing to offer.

lines.japanese: そうしなさい、そうしなさい。
lines.english: Do that. Please, do that.

lines.japanese: 「香田。味噌汁やるよ」
lines.english: “Koda. You can have my miso soup.”

lines.japanese: ありがとうの代わりに俺の大事なものを贈った。
lines.english: In place of thanks, I gave her something precious to me.
“It's lukewarm!”

lines.japanese: 不評だった。
lines.english: She was not impressed.
